facts.text: The Simpson Promise pays 100% of tuition for Iowa residents living on campus whose family adjusted gross income is at or below $100,000.

sources.title: $100K Simpson Promise - Simpson College
sources.quote: It covers the full cost of tuition (inclusive of Simpson, state and federal grant and scholarship assistance) for qualified Iowa students.
